meta.name: seo-drift
meta.description: SEO drift monitoring — snapshot a site's SEO state and detect regressions over time. Captures a baseline (rankings/positions, indexed page count, titles & meta descriptions, canonical/robots directives, schema presence, key on-page elements) and on later runs diffs against it to surface what changed: ranking drops, pages that fell out of the index, titles/metas that were accidentally overwritten (a CMS/redeploy classic), canonicals or noindex flipped, schema that disappeared. Use this skill when the user wants to monitor SEO over time, catch regressions after a site change / migration / redeploy, set a baseline, diff against a previous state, or asks "what changed on my site's SEO" or "did my redesign break SEO". Trigger on: "SEO drift", "SEO monitoring", "track SEO over time", "did my site change break SEO", "after migration SEO", "SEO regression", "baseline my SEO", "compare SEO to last month", "my titles changed", "pages fell out of the index". For a one-time full audit use /seo-analysis.

copy.tagline: 追踪网站SEO状态变化，发现排名下降和索引丢失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果定期检查网站SEO健康度，担心改版或迁移破坏排名
copy.tagline_en: Track SEO state changes and detect ranking drops and index loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly check SEO health and worry about ranking drops after changes

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 保存网站 SEO 状态的基线快照,之后再次运行时自动对比,找出排名下降、页面掉出索引、标题描述被改动、出现 noindex、结构化数据丢失等变化,并输出按严重程度排序的报告,每项附前后值和可能原因。
howto.when: 当用户提到“SEO drift”、“SEO monitoring”等关键词,或要求监控网站 SEO 变化、排查改版/迁移后的回归、对比前后状态时触发。

say.text: 给我网站建立 SEO 基线快照
say.note: Claude 会抓取当前状态并保存为基线。

say.text: 对比上次快照,看 SEO 有哪些回归
say.note: Claude 会输出差异报告,标出严重问题。

say.text: 我的网站迁移后排名掉了吗?
say.note: Claude 会对比迁移前后快照,列出排名和索引变化。

howto.what_en: Saves a baseline SEO snapshot. Later runs diff current state and report ranking drops, pages leaving index, changed titles/metas, flipped noindex, missing schema. Output: severity-ranked report with before/after values and causes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user mentions 'SEO drift'/'SEO monitoring', asks to monitor SEO, check regressions after a change/migration/redeploy, set baseline, compare to previous state, or ask about changes.

say_en.text: Create an SEO baseline snapshot for my site
say_en.note: Captures the current state and saves it as the baseline.

say_en.text: Compare with the last snapshot and show SEO regressions
say_en.note: Claude outputs a diff report and flags critical issues.

say_en.text: Did my rankings drop after the migration?
say_en.note: Compares pre/post snapshots for ranking and index changes.
